availability.note: Each cap value is keyed to its own observation date (time[:10]); no value is carried forward. Look-ahead is structurally impossible by construction; duplicate-date conflicts would be the only ambiguity and are counted above.

decision_rule.statement: RANK_BREADTH_REPRODUCED iff universe/nonempty sizes match H39; median N(d) and all band fracs/distributions match within 1e-9; every legacy per-asset rank stat matches H39; and integrity is clean (no missing source, no conflicting duplicate dates, no non-finite/non-positive values used).

label: RANK_BREADTH_REPRODUCED
note: EXPLORATORY_ONLY reproducibility + integrity diagnostic on committed development inputs. No returns, spreads, dispersion states, p-values, costs or inference computed. Does not validate, replace or unlock any confirmatory track (H1/H6/H7/H10) and is not independent confirmation. A green result proves only that H39 is reproducible from the committed inputs and that the committed cap series are internally consistent.
question: Does an independent, stdlib-only re-derivation from the committed raw cap archive, kline daily index and candidate validation reproduce the H39 RANK_BREADTH_MEASURABLE verdict, and are the committed candidate cap series free of conflicting duplicate dates and non-finite/non-positive values that would undermine that verdict?
scope_note: Computational reproducibility on the SAME committed inputs as H39; NOT an independent data-source verification. Does not change universe_frontier.json:historical_rank_coverage_state.
